Summary: B-001: Create Room Entity and Repository
Description: Create Room JPA entity with fields: id, roomNumber, capacity, building, location, amenities, isAvailable, createdAt, updatedAt. Add RoomRepository with methods like findByIsAvailable and findByCapacity. Acceptance: DB migration, unit tests, validation annotations.

Summary: B-002: Create Room Service and Controller
Description: Implement RoomService (getAll, getById, create, update, delete) and RoomController endpoints: GET /rooms, POST /rooms, PUT /rooms/{id}, DELETE /rooms/{id}. Add RoomRequest/RoomResponse DTOs and RoomMapper (MapStruct). Acceptance: integration tests for endpoints.

Summary: B-003: Enhance Application Entity with Room Preferences
Description: Extend Application entity to include accommodationType (single/shared/studio), moveInDate, duration, budget, specialRequirements and a OneToOne relation to Room. Update DTOs and mapper. Acceptance: DB migration and unit tests.

Create RoomAllocationService with an algorithm matching applications to available rooms by preferences; provide allocateRoom(applicationId) and deallocateRoom(applicationId). Validate capacity and availability; integrate with notifications. Acceptance: allocation methods and tests.

Improve DocumentService: validate file types (PDF/JPG/PNG), max size 10MB, basic virus scanning (ClamAV integration optional), duplicate detection, document expiration handling. Acceptance: validation service and unit tests.

Admin endpoints to review and verify documents. Implement status workflow PENDING→APPROVED/REJECTED, audit trail entity, email notifications and bulk processing endpoints. Acceptance: admin verify endpoint and audit logging.

Summary: B-007: Create Admin User Role and Permissions
Description: Add UserRole.ADMIN; update SecurityConfig to enforce role-based access; include @PreAuthorize on admin endpoints; seed an admin user and include roles in JWT. Acceptance: admin endpoints protected and seeded admin user.
Create analytics endpoints for admin: application stats, document queue stats, room occupancy, registration trends, dashboard summary and export. Acceptance: analytics endpoints and DTOs with tests.

Implement Notification entity and repository, EmailService (SMTP) with templates, NotificationService for events, REST endpoints for user notifications, preferences and async bulk processing. Acceptance: in-app notifications + email flow.

Enhance ApplicationService to support full workflow: submission with required fields, document requirement checks, status transitions, timeline tracking, 30-day expiration job, room allocation integration. Acceptance: end-to-end flow and integration tests.

Summary: B-011: Application Search and Filtering API
Description: Implement search/filter for applications by student name/number/status; filters for date range, type, institution; pagination/sorting; CSV export. Use JPA Criteria API for complex queries. Acceptance: /applications/search endpoint with pageable response.

Install and configure Angular Material; create custom Apple-inspired theme and system typography; build reusable shared component library and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility. Acceptance: theme + shared components and style guide.

Improve registration UX: real-time validation, progressive disclosure, helpful tooltips, integrate institution/year APIs, and add localStorage persistence. Acceptance: validated form with API integration and persistence.
Implement drag-and-drop upload, progress indicators, previews, multi-file support, validation errors and upload history UI. Acceptance: functioning upload UI and clear validation feedback.

Create a comprehensive application wizard: accommodation fields, room preference selection with images, budget slider, special requirements, T&C acceptance and progress indicator. Acceptance: multi-step wizard UI with validations.
Add detailed timeline component, status badges, required actions, history view and cancellation functionality to the tracking dashboard. Acceptance: timeline UI and action items display.
Ongoing sprint planning, backlog prioritization, daily standups (async), retrospectives, velocity tracking and impediment resolution. (Assigned to Scrum Master)
Maintain project docs, weekly status reports, meeting minutes, risk register and stakeholder communication.
Analyze business requirements, create detailed user stories with INVEST criteria and acceptance criteria; define personas and traceability matrix.
Define test strategy: unit/integration/E2E plans, coverage goals, performance and security testing checklist; create test case templates.
